name: Unemployment rate by education
description:
This dataset contains data on unemployment rates by educational attainment level, migration status, age group and gender. The default table displays 2023 data (or the latest available year) on the unemployment rates of native- and foreign-born 25-64 year-olds with below upper secondary, upper secondary or post-secondary non-tertiary, or tertiary attainment. The selection can be changed to display data by more detailed educational attainment level, by program orientation, by age at migration, by gender and by age group. Filter the time period to display historical data.

For more information, please consult the Education at a Glance web page and the OECD Handbook for Internationally Comparative Education Statistics: Concepts, Standards, Definitions and Classifications.

source_notes: Shares in this table are taken within the group the breakdowns define: the denominator has the same sex, age and other characteristics as the figure itself, not the population as a whole.

OECD splits this collection in two: a regular round covering every member, and a cyclical round that adds country of birth and age at migration for a subset. Both are here. The regular round is shown by default because it covers all 38 members; selecting a place of birth switches to the cyclical round, which covers 32.
